title: Identification of immune-related hub genes and analysis of infiltrated immune cells of idiopathic pulmonary artery hypertension
summary: Cross-dataset expression analyses and machine-learning prioritization identified CXCL10 and VIPR1 as candidate immune-related hub genes in idiopathic pulmonary arterial hypertension. The study also reported immune-cell composition differences and checked candidate genes in a small PBMC sample; these findings do not establish causal disease mechanisms.
ai_technology: LASSO and XGBoost feature selection prioritized candidate genes from integrated public expression datasets.
organization: University of California San Diego; University of California, San Francisco

source_review.scope: Primary full text, including Methods and Results; primary publication record or first result-bearing version checked.

evidence.tested: The study applied LASSO and XGBoost to expression datasets and reported RT-qPCR checks in an additional PBMC sample.
evidence.unknown: Small additional validation sample; computational gene prioritization and expression checks do not establish causal roles.
